generationInputs.prompt: A vintage snark poster rendered as an aged sepia-toned blueprint, featuring a luminous pink donut, an eggplant, and a banana, all with a diagrammatic rendering style. The central focus is a luminous pink donut, depicted with sharp, precise lines as if ink on parchment, from which two female legs emerge, clad in black fishnet stockings and black high-heeled shoes, with a slightly faded, worn texture. Two hands also extend from the donut, one holding a syringe with glowing liquid and the other a glass pipe. A sepia-toned eggplant with a syringe and a banana with a glowing syringe are positioned nearby. Viscous, glowing white liquid is subtly incorporated into the scene. The overall impression is one of historical artistry combined with a detailed, almost diagrammatic rendering style, with an even, flat lighting.
